# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Restoring Lives Through Everyday Impact: The Power of Small Actions

[Fiona Heinen]

Fiona Heinen’s journey shows growth, ownership, and patient impact in action. Supporting clinicians
and patients, she’s seen how small actions can change lives.

[ Read More ][141]
[Clement]

# Miracle Hands

[Clement] [ Learn More ][142]
[Amy Mosebrook]

# Living a Fulfilled Life

[Amy Mosebrook] [ Learn More ][143]

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

[ View our 2024 ESG Report ][144]
[Woman on mountain]

## Unleashing Possibilities in Patient Care

[ [brain scans]

### Neuro

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.
][145] [ [Doctors suturing]

### Wound Reconstruction and Care

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.
][146] [ [Doctor in surgery wearing magnifying lenses]

### Surgical Reconstruction

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.
][147] [ [Medical professional organizing medical tools on a tray]

### Surgical Instrumentation and Lighting

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.
][148] [ [Doctor performing a procedure on a patient's ear]

### Ear, Nose and Throat

Partnering with physicians to deliver new technology that enables safe, fast and effective
treatments in ENT.
][149]

## Restoring Lives

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

[ View our 2024 ESG Report ][144]
[Woman on mountain]

## Unleashing Possibilities in Patient Care

[ [brain scans]

### Neuro

We are the global leader in neurosurgery, offering a broad portfolio of products and solutions for
dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.
][145] [ [Doctors suturing]

### Wound Reconstruction and Care

Our versatile and evidence-based regenerative technologies for soft tissue reconstruction will
treat, repair and protect patients with acute and chronic complex wounds and burns.
][146] [ [Doctor in surgery wearing magnifying lenses]

### Surgical Reconstruction

We provide advanced solutions for plastic and reconstructive surgery, complex hernias, and nerve and
tendon repair and protection that support the body's natural restorative healing process.
][147] [ [Medical professional organizing medical tools on a tray]

### Surgical Instrumentation and Lighting

Explore the technological advancements in instrumentation and lighting; our solutions play a vital
role before, during and after a medial procedure leading to better patient outcomes.
][148] [ [Doctor performing a procedure on a patient's ear]

### Ear, Nose and Throat

Partnering with physicians to deliver new technology that enables safe, fast and effective
treatments in ENT.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

TOP INDICATIONS AND PROCEDURES
[ [GMC1877-shutterstock_1799586823-IN-SHAPE.png] Burn wound management Burn wounds are a global
public health problem and a leading cause of morbidity, including prolonged hospitalisation,
disfigurement and disability – often accompanied by stigma and social rejection.¹ Our aim is to help
mitigate the complications associated with burn wounds. ][11] [
[HERO-ALLEVYN-LIFE-PIP-EXPLOSION-1000X1000PX-NO-BG.png] Pressure injury prevention Trusted to reduce
the incidence of pressure injuries when used as part of a comprehensive prevention program, compared
to standard care alone.^{1-3} ][12] [ [PartialThicknessTear_HeroCutout(24901)_20250211]
Partial-thickness rotator cuff tears Partial-thickness tears can have a lasting impact on pain and
shoulder function. When used in isolated bioinductive repair, the REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant
leads to tendon healing without the need for sutured repair;^{1-4} offering patients a faster
recovery and return to activity than sutured repairs.^{4,5} ][13] [ [CARTIHEAL Procedure page Hero
Image.png] Chondral and osteochondral knee repair Treat knee cartilage lesions and osteochondral
defects in a single-stage procedure, even in the presence of mild to moderate osteoarthritis
(Kellgren-Lawrence 0-3),^{1,2} with the porous, biocompatible CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage
Repair Implant; shown to be clinically superior to the current surgical standard of care in level 1
clinical data.^{*1,2} ][14]

image from animation] REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant ][26] [ [41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story
Celebrating 170 years
Life Unlimited
Sports Medicine
Ultimate victory

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

[ Explore orthopaedic reconstruction ][91]

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

### Research innovation

Advancing patient care through innovative orthopedic research and development.

[Find out more][150]

### Clinical evidence

Delivering high impact clinical studies for better clinical care.

[Find out more][151]

### Innovation Translation

The AO's innovation powerhouse, bringing together diverse market-leading activities to better meet
current clinical needs.

[Find out more][152]

### Education

Dedicated to improving performance through outstanding educational offerings.

[Find out more][153]
[Read more][154]

## Our community

The AO is a network of over half a million health-care professionals in over 160 countries. 

[Discover AO Trauma][155]
[Discover AO Spine][156]
[Discover AO CMF][157]
[Discover AO VET][158]
[Discover AO Recon][159]
[Discover AO Sports][160]
[Find out more][161]

## Our services and resources

### AO Surgery Reference

Surgical decision made easy with literature evaluated and prepared for quick reference.

[Learn more][162]

### AO Approved Solutions

Offering detailed descriptions of AO Technical Commission Approved Solutions, including videos and
cases.

[AO Approved Solutions][163]

### Online learning

The AO is constantly looking for new ways to reach its audience, improve patient outcomes, and
enhance value for its community.

[Explore e-learning][164]

### Publications

The AO produces a diverse range of medical books, journals, and course materials/presentations.

[Explore our publications][165]
[Find out more][166]

## Our courses and events

Since the AO was founded, approximately 1.1 million surgeons and operating room personnel have
participated in AO courses in over 160 countries.

[ [AO Davos Courses visual promo] ][167]

### Build your AO Davos Courses experience! 

Join us in Davos from November 29–December 11, 2026 for the AO's flagship educational event.

[Register now][168]

### AO educational events

Each year the AO offers approximately 900 educational events around the world, supported by over
8,000 faculty, and attended by over 65,000 participants.

[Find out more][169]

### Global Spine Congress

The Global Spine Congress (GSC) is one of the biggest gatherings for thousands of spine surgeons
from all over the world.

[Find out more][170]

### Course finder

Use the course finder tool to see what's on the agenda for upcoming educational events in your
field.

[Use course finder][171]
[Use course finder][172]

### Stay in touch

Connect with us and join our AO community or subscribe to receive the latest AO news, calls, and
updates.

[Subscribe][173]

## Who we are

The AO is a medically-guided, not-for-profit organization, a global network of surgeons, and the
premier education, innovation, and research organization for the surgical treatment of trauma and
musculoskeletal disorders.

### News

Get all the latest information on AO activities, all over the world, updates from the AO community
and the most recent AO innovations.

[Find out more][142]

### Global community

Whatever stage you are at in your career, wherever you are in the world, you can be part of the AO's
international community of educators, innovators, researchers, and surgeons.

[Find out more][143]

### Our services and resources

The health care environment today is more complex than ever before. Find valuable support in AO
resources, for education, innovation, and research.

[Find out more][144]

### Contact

Explore the diverse opportunities the AO offers to specialists in a wide range of fields. Find your
AO pathway.

[Contact us][145]
[Find out more][146]

## What we do

The AO's world-leading institutes drive development, innovation, and research, across the AO by
delivering value-added products and services to the AO's clinical specialties, its global network of
surgeons and operating room personnel, and to its partners. They produce new concepts for improved
fracture care, deliver evidence-based decision making, guarantee rigorous concept and product
approval, and ensure the timely and comprehensive dissemination of knowledge and expertise. Find out
more about the [AO Research Institute Davos (ARI)][147], the [AO Innovation Translation
Center][148], the AO's clinical research activities, and the [AO Education Institute (AO EI)][149].

### Research innovation

Advancing patient care through innovative orthopedic research and development.

[Find out more][150]

### Clinical evidence

Delivering high impact clinical studies for better clinical care.

[Find out more][151]

### Innovation Translation

The AO's innovation powerhouse, bringing together diverse market-leading activities to better meet
current clinical needs.

[Find out more][152]

### Education

Dedicated to improving performance through outstanding educational offerings.

[Find out more][153]
[Read more][154]

## Our community

The AO is a network of over half a million health-care professionals in over 160 countries. 

[Discover AO Trauma][155]
[Discover AO Spine][156]
[Discover AO CMF][157]
[Discover AO VET][158]
[Discover AO Recon][159]
[Discover AO Sports][160]
[Find out more][161]

## Our services and resources

### AO Surgery Reference

Surgical decision made easy with literature evaluated and prepared for quick reference.

[Learn more][162]

### AO Approved Solutions

Offering detailed descriptions of AO Technical Commission Approved Solutions, including videos and
cases.

[AO Approved Solutions][163]

### Online learning

The AO is constantly looking for new ways to reach its audience, improve patient outcomes, and
enhance value for its community.

[Explore e-learning][164]

### Publications

The AO produces a diverse range of medical books, journals, and course materials/presentations.

[Explore our publications][165]
[Find out more][166]

## Our courses and events

Since the AO was founded, approximately 1.1 million surgeons and operating room personnel have
participated in AO courses in over 160 countries.

[ [AO Davos Courses visual promo] ][167]

### Build your AO Davos Courses experience! 

Join us in Davos from November 29–December 11, 2026 for the AO's flagship educational event.

[Register now][168]

### AO educational events

Each year the AO offers approximately 900 educational events around the world, supported by over
8,000 faculty, and attended by over 65,000 participants.

[Find out more][169]

### Global Spine Congress

The Global Spine Congress (GSC) is one of the biggest gatherings for thousands of spine surgeons
from all over the world.

[Find out more][170]

### Course finder

Use the course finder tool to see what's on the agenda for upcoming educational events in your
field.

[Use course finder][171]
[Use course finder][172]

### Stay in touch

Connect with us and join our AO community or subscribe to receive the latest AO news, calls, and
updates.

[Subscribe][173]

## Excellence • Innovation • Compassion

### Since 1987

# The Seacoast’s Best Orthopedic Practice

Our NH based team of Board-Certified physicians utilizes the latest advancements in orthopedics and
sports medicine, coupled with preventive and surgical techniques. Pain shouldn’t hold you back from
doing what you love. Here at Atlantic Orthopaedics & Sports Medicine, we promise to get your body
back in motion and feeling great. 

[Get To Know Us][97]

## Our Specialties

We specialize in orthopedic care ranging from concussion care, pain management, sports medicine, and
more. From fracture care to total joint replacement to sports-related injuries, we take care of
you…mind, body, sport, and life.

Our NH based team of Board-Certified physicians utilizes the latest advancements in orthopedics and
sports medicine, coupled with preventive and surgical techniques. Pain shouldn’t hold you back from
doing what you love. Here at Atlantic Orthopaedics & Sports Medicine, we promise to get your body
back in motion and feeling great.

you are welcome not just a customer. A refreshing place to deal with when maybe you aren’t feeling
your best. I highly recommend this place.”

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][64]

Bioinnovation Venture Accelerator Bridging the translation Gap: Idea to Exit


Esco Aster is a biotech factory helping to spin out our existing Tide Motion bioprocess products
and/or services with the fastest time to clinic, using our standardized, linearly scalable
biomanufacturing platforms that are globally investable and backed by an exit strategy ensuring
returns to all stakeholders — from the public, founders, foundations, and nonprofits to financial
investors.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][65]

cGMP CRDMO


cGMP-integrated contract research, development, and manufacturing organization. Esco Aster operates
two dedicated certified sites: one focused on clinical medicine, veterinary medicine, and
dermocosmetics; the other focused on clinical cell-based and derivative nutrition, and
nutricosmetics.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][66]

Advancing the Future of Medicine Through Innovation


At Esco Aster, we empower the development of next-generation medicines by combining advanced
bioprocess solutions, translational research, and scalable manufacturing support. From discovery to
commercialization, we help innovators accelerate breakthroughs in biologics, cell and gene therapy,
vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Enabling Next-Generation Clinical Nutritional Solutions


Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

These products are developed for both companion animals and humans, ensuring clinical benefits for
improved skin health and gut microbiome function. This enables precision nutrition for cancer
patients as well as wellness and longevity applications aimed at increasing health span, not just
lifespan.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# meidrix biomedicals GmbH

#### Als innovatives Biotechnologie-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Esslingen sind wir spezialisiert auf
#### regenerative, biologische Medizinprodukte. Die Entwicklung und Herstellung von
#### orthobiologischen Implantaten auf natürlicher Kollagenbasis für die regenerative
#### Gelenkknorpeltherapie ist unsere Passion. Den Erhalt Ihrer Lebensqualität und Mobilität durch
#### natürliche Regeneration verstehen wir als unseren Focus.

#### Aus dieser Forschung und Entwicklung entstand das innovative Produkt ChondroFiller^{®} liquid,
#### für die regenerative Knorpeltherapie.

#### Bei Fragen rund um das Produkt ChondroFiller^{®} liquid, steht unser Team Ihnen gerne unter der
#### E-Mail-Adresse [info@meidrix.de][30] zur Verfügung.

[Knorpelregeneration][31]

## ChondroFiller^{® }liquid

#### ChondroFiller^{®} liquid wird für die Behandlung von Knorpeldefekten bis zu 3 cm² eingesetzt.

Die Anwendung ist auch in schwer zugänglichen Bereichen der Gelenke (z.B. retropatellar) möglich und
kann mit hochinnovativen Verfahren der Arthroskopie und Nano-Arthroskopie durchgeführt werden.

Das orthobiologische Knorpelimplantat mit einzigartiger, patentierter Implantationstechnologie
ermöglicht die regenerative, schonende und effektive Behandlung von Knorpelverletzungen in
unterschiedlichen Gelenken, wie Knie, Sprunggelenk, Hüfte und Schulter.

# meidrix biomedicals GmbH

#### Als innovatives Biotechnologie-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Esslingen sind wir spezialisiert auf
#### regenerative, biologische Medizinprodukte. Die Entwicklung und Herstellung von
#### orthobiologischen Implantaten auf natürlicher Kollagenbasis für die regenerative
#### Gelenkknorpeltherapie ist unsere Passion. Den Erhalt Ihrer Lebensqualität und Mobilität durch
#### natürliche Regeneration verstehen wir als unseren Focus.

#### Aus dieser Forschung und Entwicklung entstand das innovative Produkt ChondroFiller^{®} liquid,
#### für die regenerative Knorpeltherapie.

#### Bei Fragen rund um das Produkt ChondroFiller^{®} liquid, steht unser Team Ihnen gerne unter der
#### E-Mail-Adresse [info@meidrix.de][30] zur Verfügung.

[Knorpelregeneration][31]

## ChondroFiller^{® }liquid

#### ChondroFiller^{®} liquid wird für die Behandlung von Knorpeldefekten bis zu 3 cm² eingesetzt.

Die Anwendung ist auch in schwer zugänglichen Bereichen der Gelenke (z.B. retropatellar) möglich und
kann mit hochinnovativen Verfahren der Arthroskopie und Nano-Arthroskopie durchgeführt werden.

Das orthobiologische Knorpelimplantat mit einzigartiger, patentierter Implantationstechnologie
ermöglicht die regenerative, schonende und effektive Behandlung von Knorpelverletzungen in
unterschiedlichen Gelenken, wie Knie, Sprunggelenk, Hüfte und Schulter.

## Bringing Orthopedics & Arthroscopy to a World In Need

## LOCATIONS

Our Mission Statement:

Goals:

The mission of Operation Arthroscopy is to “bring orthopedics and arthroscopy to a world in need.”


By providing orthopedic medical supplies and training to under-served communities and countries, we
hope to build kinship and understanding while improving the quality of life in these communities.


Inspired by their love and compassion for humanity, William and Erica Stetson created Operation
Arthroscopy, a small, grassroots, non-profit organization that is a 501(c)3 corporation in 2004.
* Collect and donate arthroscopic and medical equipment and supplies to countries who have
  difficulty accessing current medical technology.
* Organize and execute global medical missions to teach orthopedics and arthroscopic techniques. Our
  aim is to introduce, refine, and create a sustainable practice of these teachings that will help
  advance medicine abroad.


In pursuit of this mission, Operation Arthroscopy serves as a platform for collecting and delivering
donated medical supplies, providing hands on training, as well as operating with the local surgeons.

## Bringing Orthopedics & Arthroscopy to a World In Need

## LOCATIONS

Our Mission Statement:

Goals:

The mission of Operation Arthroscopy is to “bring orthopedics and arthroscopy to a world in need.”


By providing orthopedic medical supplies and training to under-served communities and countries, we
hope to build kinship and understanding while improving the quality of life in these communities.


Inspired by their love and compassion for humanity, William and Erica Stetson created Operation
Arthroscopy, a small, grassroots, non-profit organization that is a 501(c)3 corporation in 2004.
* Collect and donate arthroscopic and medical equipment and supplies to countries who have
  difficulty accessing current medical technology.
* Organize and execute global medical missions to teach orthopedics and arthroscopic techniques. Our
  aim is to introduce, refine, and create a sustainable practice of these teachings that will help
  advance medicine abroad.


In pursuit of this mission, Operation Arthroscopy serves as a platform for collecting and delivering
donated medical supplies, providing hands on training, as well as operating with the local surgeons.

NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

[Fix Appointment][113]

**Orthopedic Implants & Instruments**: Quality and trust are two major factors that orthopedic
surgeons consider when selecting orthopedic implants. Orthopedic experts worldwide not only trust
NET Orthopedic Implants but also confidently recommend them to their peers due to their high
quality. Narang Medical Limited operates its own state-of-the-art factory dedicated to manufacturing
Orthopedic Implants and Instruments. This factory is one of the largest in India, equipped with
skilled production staff of approximately 250 people. As a leading manufacturer and supplier of
orthopedic implants, we have established ourselves as a top orthopedic company. Narang Medical Ltd.
is based in India.

Narang Medical is a leading orthopedic implant company that develops a wide range of orthopedic
implant technologies to assist orthopedic medical professionals worldwide. Nearly 100% of our
orthopedic implants are shipped to over 80 countries, making us one of the **world's top orthopedic
implant companies**. Our company operates under a quality system that adheres to **ISO 9001:2015,
ISO 13485:2016, CE, and WHO: GMP Compliance**. Narang Medical Limited currently **supplies
orthopedic implants** in titanium and stainless steel, and many reputable companies in Europe and
the USA regularly purchase orthopedic implants from us. As a leading **manufacturer** and supplier
of an extensive range of orthopedic implants and instruments, we are recognized as one of the top
orthopedic implant companies, not only in India but also globally.

**Why should you source from us?**

We are a renowned manufacturer and supplier of a diverse range of medical and surgical products,
including orthopedic implants. With our expertise and dedication to quality, we have established
ourselves as a trusted name in the field of orthopedic implant manufacturing.

Orthopedic implants play a crucial role in the treatment of various musculoskeletal conditions and
injuries. These implants are designed to provide stability, support, and alignment to the affected
bones and joints, facilitating the healing process and restoring mobility for patients.

As one of the leading **orthopedic implant manufacturers**, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of
implants catering to different orthopedic needs. Our product range includes implants for joint
replacement surgeries, such as hip implants, knee implants, and shoulder implants. These implants
are engineered with precision to ensure proper fit, durability, and compatibility with the patient's
anatomy.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implant offerings also encompass **trauma implants**, which are used in
the treatment of fractures and other traumatic injuries. These implants, including plates, screws,
and nails, are designed to provide stability and support during the healing process, promoting
optimal recovery.

In addition to our wide range of orthopedic implants, we as a leading manufacturer emphasize on
quality assurance and adheres to stringent manufacturing standards. Our products are manufactured
using high-quality materials, ensuring reliability, strength, and biocompatibility. The company's
commitment to maintaining international quality standards has earned us recognition and trust among
healthcare professionals globally.

Narang Medical's orthopedic implants undergo rigorous testing and quality control measures to ensure
safety and efficacy. The implants are designed in consultation with orthopedic surgeons,
incorporating their expertise and feedback to meet the evolving needs of the medical community.

As a customer-centric organization, Narang Medical strives to provide comprehensive support to
healthcare providers. They offer technical assistance, training, and educational resources to
surgeons and medical staff, facilitating the successful implantation and use of their products.

In conclusion, Narang Medical is a leading manufacturer of orthopedic implants, offering a wide
range of high-quality products for joint replacement surgeries and trauma cases. With their focus on
quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction, Narang Medical continues to contribute to
advancements in orthopedic care and improve the lives of patients worldwide.

a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. # RZ Medizintechnik

## Progress
## in Surgery

Medizinische Produkte für die Endoskopie, Instrumente für die offene Chirurgie, Geräte und Optiken,
Dienstleistungen und Kooperationen, sowie unser RZ Service bilden seit 1995 die Basis des
unabhängigen Familienunternehmens RZ Medizintechnik.
[zur Produkt-Übersicht][153]

## Herzlich willkommen

RZ Medizintechnik ist ein hundertprozentiges Familienunternehmen mit Tradition. Unsere Kunden,
Geschäftspartner und Mitarbeiter können sich darauf verlassen, dass wir unseren Werten und
Grundsätzen stets treu bleiben. Aufgrund unserer kompromisslosen Einstellung bezüglich der Qualität
und Verarbeitung unserer Produkte genießen wir einen ausgezeichneten Ruf weltweit und vertreiben
unsere Hightech-Produkte auf allen Kontinenten in über 52 Ländern.
* Produktportfolio

## Für jeden Fachbereich

Operationen durch das Schlüsselloch? Darin liegt unser Produktfokus. Unser Endoskopie Programm –
dessen fortwährende Weiterentwicklung uns am Herzen liegt – beinhaltet:
* Eine moderne Gerätelinie
* Full-HD, 4K und ICG/NIR Endoskope für alle Bereiche
* Eine große Auswahl an dezidierten und spezialisierten Instrumenten

Unser breites Spektrum in der Endoskopie fokussiert sich vor allem auf:
* Urologie
* Gynäkologie
* Laparoskopie
* Arthroskopie
* HNO - Hals-Nasen-Ohren Chirurgie

Zudem entwickeln und liefern wir hochwertige Instrumente und Serviceleistungen für die
Allgemeinchirurgie und bieten mehr als 10000 verschiedene Instrumentenvarianten.

[ zur Produkt-übersicht ][154]
* Leitbild

## Unsere Werte

Es gibt vier Grundpfeiler, auf denen unser Unternehmen basiert: 
* Qualität,
* Regionalität,
* Nachhaltigkeit und
* Familienfreundlichkeit.

Die Qualität der RZ-Produkte steht an höchster Stelle. Um unseren Qualitätsstandard stets
einzuhalten, bauen wir bei der Zusammenarbeit vor allem auf regionale Partner. Die Nähe
gewährleistet einen besonderen, regen Austausch wodurch gegenseitiges Vertrauen aufgebaut wird.

In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch die Nachhaltigkeit der RZ-Produkte immer weiter ausgebaut. Wir
wissen aber auch, dass unser Erfolg nur mit zufriedenen, vertrauenswürdigen Mitarbeitern möglich
ist. Deshalb ist es uns ein besonderes Anliegen stets ein offenes Ohr für sie zu haben, um die
Zufriedenheit so stetig zu steigern. Sei es mit der Möglichkeit zum Home-Office, verschiedenen
Teilzeit-Modellen oder Sonderleistungen.
* Service

## Wir haben die Antwort

Das Betreiben, Anwenden und die Instandhaltung von Medizinprodukten unterliegt strengen gesetzlichen
Vorgaben und erfordert ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit und Erfahrung. Bei RZ Medizintechnik
vereinen wir unsere fachliche Expertise mit der Leidenschaft, Sie zu unterstützen. Deshalb ist unser
Serviceteam der kompetente Partner an ihrer Seite, wenn es um wichtige Kaufentscheidungen, wie der
problemlosen Lieferung von Ersatzteilen und Zubehör, der schnellen Problemdiagnostik sowie
technischer Schulungen geht.

# RZ Medizintechnik

## Progress
## in Surgery

Medizinische Produkte für die Endoskopie, Instrumente für die offene Chirurgie, Geräte und Optiken,
Dienstleistungen und Kooperationen, sowie unser RZ Service bilden seit 1995 die Basis des
unabhängigen Familienunternehmens RZ Medizintechnik.
[zur Produkt-Übersicht][153]

## Herzlich willkommen

RZ Medizintechnik ist ein hundertprozentiges Familienunternehmen mit Tradition. Unsere Kunden,
Geschäftspartner und Mitarbeiter können sich darauf verlassen, dass wir unseren Werten und
Grundsätzen stets treu bleiben. Aufgrund unserer kompromisslosen Einstellung bezüglich der Qualität
und Verarbeitung unserer Produkte genießen wir einen ausgezeichneten Ruf weltweit und vertreiben
unsere Hightech-Produkte auf allen Kontinenten in über 52 Ländern.
* Produktportfolio

## Für jeden Fachbereich

Operationen durch das Schlüsselloch? Darin liegt unser Produktfokus. Unser Endoskopie Programm –
dessen fortwährende Weiterentwicklung uns am Herzen liegt – beinhaltet:
* Eine moderne Gerätelinie
* Full-HD, 4K und ICG/NIR Endoskope für alle Bereiche
* Eine große Auswahl an dezidierten und spezialisierten Instrumenten

Unser breites Spektrum in der Endoskopie fokussiert sich vor allem auf:
* Urologie
* Gynäkologie
* Laparoskopie
* Arthroskopie
* HNO - Hals-Nasen-Ohren Chirurgie

Zudem entwickeln und liefern wir hochwertige Instrumente und Serviceleistungen für die
Allgemeinchirurgie und bieten mehr als 10000 verschiedene Instrumentenvarianten.

[ zur Produkt-übersicht ][154]
* Leitbild

## Unsere Werte

Es gibt vier Grundpfeiler, auf denen unser Unternehmen basiert: 
* Qualität,
* Regionalität,
* Nachhaltigkeit und
* Familienfreundlichkeit.

Die Qualität der RZ-Produkte steht an höchster Stelle. Um unseren Qualitätsstandard stets
einzuhalten, bauen wir bei der Zusammenarbeit vor allem auf regionale Partner. Die Nähe
gewährleistet einen besonderen, regen Austausch wodurch gegenseitiges Vertrauen aufgebaut wird.

In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch die Nachhaltigkeit der RZ-Produkte immer weiter ausgebaut. Wir
wissen aber auch, dass unser Erfolg nur mit zufriedenen, vertrauenswürdigen Mitarbeitern möglich
ist. Deshalb ist es uns ein besonderes Anliegen stets ein offenes Ohr für sie zu haben, um die
Zufriedenheit so stetig zu steigern. Sei es mit der Möglichkeit zum Home-Office, verschiedenen
Teilzeit-Modellen oder Sonderleistungen.
* Service

## Wir haben die Antwort

Das Betreiben, Anwenden und die Instandhaltung von Medizinprodukten unterliegt strengen gesetzlichen
Vorgaben und erfordert ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit und Erfahrung. Bei RZ Medizintechnik
vereinen wir unsere fachliche Expertise mit der Leidenschaft, Sie zu unterstützen. Deshalb ist unser
Serviceteam der kompetente Partner an ihrer Seite, wenn es um wichtige Kaufentscheidungen, wie der
problemlosen Lieferung von Ersatzteilen und Zubehör, der schnellen Problemdiagnostik sowie
technischer Schulungen geht.

# Precision *forged*
# for the **operating room**

From our manufacturing floor in Ankara to operating theatres across Türkiye, Northern Cyprus, and
beyond — Sima Medical specializes in arthroscopy, spinal, and cranial neurosurgery. We produce and
distribute surgical instruments engineered for these demanding disciplines.

[Our Capabilities →][7] [Request a Meeting][8]

Where craftsmanship meets surgical precision.
Our Heritage

## A decade of *surgical* expertise

Founded in 2015, Sima Medical began as a specialist trader in surgical implants and instruments —
focused on arthroscopic orthopedic surgery and brain & spine neurosurgery. Through close
collaboration with surgeons across Türkiye, we built deep expertise in these demanding clinical
fields.

In 2022, we crossed a defining threshold — achieving ISO 13485 certification and launching our own
production line of surgical hand instruments. Today, we are both manufacturer and distributor,
exporter and importer, supplier and partner.

Led by a founder with seventeen years of industry experience, Sima Medical operates as the company's
MOH-licensed Responsible Manager — a designation that reflects our regulatory rigor and clinical
accountability.

17+
Years Industry Experience
Founder-led expertise in surgical instruments and medical device regulation.
2022
In-House Manufacturing
ISO 13485 production line for surgical hand instruments.
From Raw Material to Operating Room

## The Sima *process*

Every instrument we produce moves through four disciplined stages — engineered to meet the standards
demanded by Turkish state hospitals, university medical centers, and international procurement
teams.

01 / Design
Engineered with surgeons
Each instrument geometry is refined through dialogue with surgical teams, ensuring ergonomics and
clinical performance.
02 / Manufacture
Forged & finished
Surgical-grade stainless steel, precision machined and hand-finished under ISO 13485 quality
controls.
03 / Validate
Tested to standard
Dimensional, mechanical and functional verification against medical device regulations before
release.
04 / Deliver
Operating room ready
Sterilization-ready packaging and direct distribution to hospitals, clinics, and surgical centers.
Clinical Focus

## Three *specialized* branches

We don't try to be everything to everyone. Sima Medical is purpose-built around three surgical
disciplines — and the depth of focus shows in every instrument we manufacture and every product we
distribute.

Orthopedics

### Arthroscopy

Minimally invasive joint surgery. We supply arthroscopy instruments, implants, and consumables for
shoulder, knee, hip, and ankle procedures — partnering with orthopedic surgeons across our network.

Neurosurgery

### Spinal Surgery

Pedicle screw systems, cervical and lumbar spinal fixation, interbody cages, and related
instrumentation — supporting neurosurgeons performing complex spinal interventions.

Neurosurgery

### Cranial Surgery

Cranial fixation systems, neurosurgical instruments, intraoperative nerve monitoring, and surgical
navigation systems — equipping operating rooms for brain surgery procedures.

What We Do

## *Six* capabilities, one partner

From in-house manufacturing to international distributorship and intraoperative device rental — Sima
Medical operates across the full surgical supply chain.

01

### Surgical Instrument Manufacturing

We design and produce high-precision surgical hand instruments under ISO 13485 quality management.
Built for orthopedic and neurosurgical demands.

In-House Production
02

### Implant & Device Trading

Spinal systems, cranial neurosurgery instruments, and arthroscopy supplies — supplied to hospitals,
clinics, and surgical centers across our markets.

Hospital Network
03

### International Distribution

Authorized Turkish distributor for two internationally recognized medical device manufacturers —
connecting global products to local healthcare.

Two Exclusive Partnerships
04

### Device Rental Services

Intraoperative nerve monitoring and surgical navigation systems on flexible rental terms — advanced
technology, without capital outlay.

On-Demand Technology
05

### Import & Export Operations

As Turkish Exporters Assembly (TİM) members, we handle full customs and regulatory compliance —
bridging international suppliers with Turkish medicine.

TİM Reg. No. 42714
06

### Public Tender Participation

Where craftsmanship meets surgical precision.
Our Heritage

## A decade of *surgical* expertise

Founded in 2015, Sima Medical began as a specialist trader in surgical implants and instruments —
focused on arthroscopic orthopedic surgery and brain & spine neurosurgery. Through close
collaboration with surgeons across Türkiye, we built deep expertise in these demanding clinical
fields.

In 2022, we crossed a defining threshold — achieving ISO 13485 certification and launching our own
production line of surgical hand instruments. Today, we are both manufacturer and distributor,
exporter and importer, supplier and partner.

Led by a founder with seventeen years of industry experience, Sima Medical operates as the company's
MOH-licensed Responsible Manager — a designation that reflects our regulatory rigor and clinical
accountability.

17+
Years Industry Experience
Founder-led expertise in surgical instruments and medical device regulation.
2022
In-House Manufacturing
ISO 13485 production line for surgical hand instruments.
From Raw Material to Operating Room

## The Sima *process*

Every instrument we produce moves through four disciplined stages — engineered to meet the standards
demanded by Turkish state hospitals, university medical centers, and international procurement
teams.

01 / Design
Engineered with surgeons
Each instrument geometry is refined through dialogue with surgical teams, ensuring ergonomics and
clinical performance.
02 / Manufacture
Forged & finished
Surgical-grade stainless steel, precision machined and hand-finished under ISO 13485 quality
controls.
03 / Validate
Tested to standard
Dimensional, mechanical and functional verification against medical device regulations before
release.
04 / Deliver
Operating room ready
Sterilization-ready packaging and direct distribution to hospitals, clinics, and surgical centers.
Clinical Focus

## Three *specialized* branches

We don't try to be everything to everyone. Sima Medical is purpose-built around three surgical
disciplines — and the depth of focus shows in every instrument we manufacture and every product we
distribute.

Orthopedics

### Arthroscopy

Minimally invasive joint surgery. We supply arthroscopy instruments, implants, and consumables for
shoulder, knee, hip, and ankle procedures — partnering with orthopedic surgeons across our network.

Neurosurgery

### Spinal Surgery

Pedicle screw systems, cervical and lumbar spinal fixation, interbody cages, and related
instrumentation — supporting neurosurgeons performing complex spinal interventions.

Neurosurgery

### Cranial Surgery

Cranial fixation systems, neurosurgical instruments, intraoperative nerve monitoring, and surgical
navigation systems — equipping operating rooms for brain surgery procedures.

What We Do

## *Six* capabilities, one partner

From in-house manufacturing to international distributorship and intraoperative device rental — Sima
Medical operates across the full surgical supply chain.

01

### Surgical Instrument Manufacturing

We design and produce high-precision surgical hand instruments under ISO 13485 quality management.
Built for orthopedic and neurosurgical demands.

In-House Production
02

### Implant & Device Trading

Spinal systems, cranial neurosurgery instruments, and arthroscopy supplies — supplied to hospitals,
clinics, and surgical centers across our markets.

Hospital Network
03

### International Distribution

Authorized Turkish distributor for two internationally recognized medical device manufacturers —
connecting global products to local healthcare.

Two Exclusive Partnerships
04

### Device Rental Services

Intraoperative nerve monitoring and surgical navigation systems on flexible rental terms — advanced
technology, without capital outlay.

On-Demand Technology
05

### Import & Export Operations

As Turkish Exporters Assembly (TİM) members, we handle full customs and regulatory compliance —
bridging international suppliers with Turkish medicine.

TİM Reg. No. 42714
06

### Public Tender Participation

Active supplier in Turkish Ministry of Health public tenders — serving state hospitals and
university medical centers with certified surgical materials.

MOH Authorized

Sima Medical operates as part of a three-company group — alongside Health-X Medical in the United
States and Defne Medical in Northern Cyprus. Together, we span manufacturing, global distribution,
and regional supply.

# About Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services

Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services offer comprehensive care for the full range of injuries and
medical conditions affecting the musculoskeletal system. At their offices in Visalia, Porterville,
Selma and Tulare, California, they proudly offer fast and easy-to-schedule appointments so patients
can get the pain relief and treatment they need without waiting.

The team includes board-eligble and certified orthopaedic and hand surgeons with decades of
experience and advanced training. Though they have exceptional surgical skills, they're fully
trained to provide nonsurgical care. The team always creates personalized treatment plans that begin
with the most appropriate nonsurgical therapies.

Patients often seek care at Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services for acute injuries, such as
[fractures][39], tendon, and nerve injuries, as well as ongoing [wrist][40], [hand][41], and
[shoulder pain][42]. As part of their holistic pain management, the team may recommend exercises and
preventive tips together with injections that ease pain and promote healing.

Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services often treat common conditions such as [arthritis][43],
[carpal tunnel syndrome][44], and rotator cuff injuries. After trying conservative treatments, they
may recommend surgery to repair the underlying problem.

The team specializes in minimally invasive surgery, including hand and wrist, using today's most
advanced technology. 

Call the nearest office or book online today to learn more about their services or schedule an
appointment.

# About Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services

Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services offer comprehensive care for the full range of injuries and
medical conditions affecting the musculoskeletal system. At their offices in Visalia, Porterville,
Selma and Tulare, California, they proudly offer fast and easy-to-schedule appointments so patients
can get the pain relief and treatment they need without waiting.

The team includes board-eligble and certified orthopaedic and hand surgeons with decades of
experience and advanced training. Though they have exceptional surgical skills, they're fully
trained to provide nonsurgical care. The team always creates personalized treatment plans that begin
with the most appropriate nonsurgical therapies.

Patients often seek care at Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services for acute injuries, such as
[fractures][39], tendon, and nerve injuries, as well as ongoing [wrist][40], [hand][41], and
[shoulder pain][42]. As part of their holistic pain management, the team may recommend exercises and
preventive tips together with injections that ease pain and promote healing.

Sequoia Institute for Surgical Services often treat common conditions such as [arthritis][43],
[carpal tunnel syndrome][44], and rotator cuff injuries. After trying conservative treatments, they
may recommend surgery to repair the underlying problem.

The team specializes in minimally invasive surgery, including hand and wrist, using today's most
advanced technology. 

Call the nearest office or book online today to learn more about their services or schedule an
appointment.

## Article of the day

[Oppenheims Sign][44]
Oppenheim’s Sign is a neurological reflex used to assess upper motor neuron lesions. It is elicited
by stroking the tibial crest and observing for a Babinski-like response.
